what: ICE asked the IRS for the last known addresses of about 1.28 million people; the IRS gave 47,289.
status: Limited by courts. A D.C. order, upheld on September 8, 2026, bars sharing except in strict compliance with tax law. A Massachusetts order (February 2026, on appeal) bars ICE from using addresses already received. In a separate case the D.C. Circuit let the agreement itself stand (February 2026).

what: Personal data on Medicaid enrollees (not only immigrants), including home addresses, shared with ICE from June 2025.
status: While the lawsuit goes on, a federal judge allows only basic biographical, location and contact information about immigrants living in the U.S. illegally, in the 22 states that sued.

what: A reported agreement (April 2025) to share the addresses of 98,000 people, then a formal agreement with ICE in August 2025 for monthly requests covering about 50,000 people.
status: A federal court declined to block it in January 2026.
